cases.source_shape: A captured page has an operations-looking path but its body is a product acceptance specification.
cases.recovery: Read the complete authorized evidence before returning a Section intent.

cases.source_shape: A long page preview shows only headings while the required evidence view still has unread pages.
cases.recovery: Follow the current workset evidence continuation before authoring.

cases.source_shape: One document contains product behavior, technical design, and a recovery procedure.
cases.recovery: Split along continuous reader-task boundaries and return registered intents.

cases.source_shape: The target-resolution view contains an exact current subject with matching evidence.
cases.recovery: Use the supplied target identity and leave identity derivation to Context.

cases.source_shape: A separately named component has its own contract, lifecycle, and standalone reader questions.
cases.recovery: Bind the independent decision to current evidence and a permitted SubjectKey schema.

cases.source_shape: A local heading contains one warning that only makes sense inside the parent guide.
cases.recovery: Keep the warning as a source-backed Section under the owning Artifact.

cases.source_shape: A page contains labels and unresolved links but no citable reader content.
cases.recovery: Return the registered missing-material or unsupported disposition.

cases.source_shape: A fragmented note contains many short independent claims.
cases.recovery: Keep evidence windows narrow, then apply the normal semantic gates.

cases.source_shape: Two paragraphs repeat the same claim for the same reader task and authority.
cases.recovery: Retain one canonical statement with its evidence boundary.

cases.source_shape: Two current sources disagree and the workset supplies no precedence.
cases.recovery: Return a material question or supported diagnostic instead of guessing.

cases.source_shape: A cited Section explicitly states that one authorized component consumes another component's output.
cases.recovery: Keep the claim only under the Section carrying relation evidence.

cases.source_shape: The source explicitly describes a possible cause, while the structured schema has no confidence field.
cases.recovery: Keep Agent uncertainty unresolved and preserve only source-authored uncertainty.

cases.source_shape: An accepted Result carries a current SubjectKey and Section projection intents.
cases.recovery: Recompute the proposal from the current Result and contract.

cases.source_shape: Two proposals claim the same Node, Artifact, Section, or output path.
cases.recovery: Return to current subject resolution instead of mutating a path.

cases.source_shape: A current Artifact would be removed or moved after a new Result.
cases.recovery: Bind one human confirmation to the exact base and target digests.

cases.source_shape: A Section is only an unanswered placeholder and the analyzer supplies an eligible omission reason.
cases.recovery: Use the exact eligible omission reason and preserve lifecycle audit in Context.

cases.source_shape: A question has an evidence-backed answer and a deprecation names its replacement.
cases.recovery: Repair or reshape without removing the answer or replacement.

cases.source_shape: A Section contains an ambiguous owner or link purpose that current evidence cannot recover.
cases.recovery: Ask one concise batched question after completing independent safe work.

cases.source_shape: The workset, profile contract, or source digest changes before layout acceptance.
cases.recovery: Resume from the fresh Context route and recompute the bound Result and layout.

cases.source_shape: The same current quality problem survives three accepted revision attempts while other Sections pass.
cases.recovery: Ask for content organization, source fidelity, or missing material once.
